etymology: from a derivative of 06031 with prepositional prefix
definition:
Baana or Baanah = "in affliction"

 1) a Benjamite, son Rimmon, who with his brother Rechab murdered
    Ish-bosheth. For this, killed by David, mutilated bodies hung up
    over the pool at Hebron
 2) a Netophathite, father of Heleb or Heled, one of David's mighty warriors
 3) the head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
 4) a chief of the people
